classifications.notes: Black-and-white 4-panel collage of Steve Jobs demonstrating the original Macintosh to Andy Warhol and Keith Haring. Iconic cultural crossover moment from the 1980s.
Alex Karp seated in a suit with signature wild curly hair, red bandana/scarf, and purple sweater. Distinctive eccentric CEO look.
Black-and-white profile shot of a man in sunglasses and sleeveless white tee smoking a cigarette. Moody, aesthetic crypto-bro archetype photo.
Famous 1977 Albuquerque police mugshot of a young Bill Gates, side and front view. APD booking number 105519, dated 12-13-77.
Joe Gebbia (Airbnb co-founder) and Isabelle Boemeke at the Met Gala. She wears a dramatic black leather and gold outfit; he wears a polka-dot tuxedo.
Young Elon Musk in a leather jacket standing next to a 'LIBERTY' poster. Early-era photo with long hair and goth-adjacent aesthetic.
Ben Horowitz and his wife Felicia walking casually outdoors, likely at Sun Valley or similar tech conference. She wears a 'Feminist' skirt; he's in casual layered attire.
Classic black-and-white photograph of the Wright Brothers walking side by side in bowler hats and suits. Iconic early 1900s image of the aviation pioneers.
John Romero and John Carmack posing back-to-back holding fantasy swords/weapons against a purple-lit backdrop. Iconic 1990s id Software promo shot for DOOM creators.
Craig Federighi (Apple SVP) holding a basketball in a white tracksuit with rainbow stripes and Swift logo at Apple Park. Fun, sporty WWDC-style promo image.
Young Sean Parker with curly bleached blonde hair, wearing a red leather jacket and blue V-neck with a chain necklace. Distinctly early-2000s party aesthetic.
Pavel Durov sitting barefoot on sand dunes in all black clothing. Striking editorial-style shot of the Telegram founder, very cinematic desert composition.
Steve Wozniak and David Lee Roth (Van Halen) backstage, both holding drinks and posing together. Fun 1980s tech-meets-rock crossover moment.
John McAfee wearing a samurai helmet and holding a shotgun while standing next to a classic muscle car in a wooded area. Peak McAfee eccentricity.
Jack Ma performing on stage in full punk rock costume — white wig with red spiky mohawk, studded leather jacket, sunglasses, holding a microphone. Famous Alibaba annual party performance.
Stephen Watt shirtless in a pool at night holding a bottle of Moet & Chandon champagne. The convicted hacker and former Morgan Stanley programmer living a flashy lifestyle.
Young Julian Assange in 1995 outside a courthouse wearing a dark blazer, tie, and round sunglasses with long hair. Taken during his early hacking charges in Melbourne.
